Class DriverStatistics

java.lang.Object
DriverStatistics
public class DriverStatistics extends Object
Stores calculated statistics for a Formula 1 driver. Includes races, wins, podiums, points, and average finish.

  • Constructor Details

    • DriverStatistics

      public DriverStatistics(String name, int races, int wins, int podiums, int points, double avg)
      Creates a DriverStatistics object containing the performance statistics for a Formula 1 driver. Stores the driver's name, total races, wins, podium finishes, championship points, and average finishing position.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the Formula 1 driver
      races - the total number of races completed
      wins - the total number of race victories
      podiums - the total number of podium finishes
      points - the total championship points earned
      avg - the driver's average finishing position
